title: Ninh Binh in a day
summary: The sampan at Trang An, crisp rice on the way, and the temples at Hoa Lu. Kim Son and Van Long are a second day.

days.title: Sao Khe, then Hoa Lu
days.body: Start with the sampan if you slept in the valley. Eat crisp rice on the roads toward the sights. Walk the Dinh and Le temples in the afternoon. Bai Dinh, Van Long, and Phat Diem do not fit this day unless you drop one of the three stops. Minutes between them are Check on arrival.

stops.name: Trang An
stops.note: Take the sampan on the Sao Khe.

stops.name: Com chay
stops.note: Eat crisp rice between the sights.

stops.name: Hoa Lu
stops.note: Walk the Dinh and Le temples in the afternoon.

additions.name: Van Long
additions.note: Save Van Long for another day on the water.

additions.name: Bai Dinh Pagoda
additions.note: Leave Bai Dinh for a day when this loop is not the plan.

additions.name: Phat Diem stone church
additions.note: Leave Phat Diem for a separate day.

seoTitle: Ninh Binh in a day — Trang An, then Hoa Lu
seoDescription: One day in the valley: the Trang An sampan, crisp rice, and Hoa Lu. A minute count for each stop is Check on arrival.
